changelog:
# RevisionistShardsHistory Changelog
## v1.0.2
- Minor refactors.
## v1.0.1
- Disable rewards animations in fake chests by default (this is a toggleable setting).
  - This feature goes for anyone trying to give themselves two billion of everything. It ***__WILL NOT__*** fully eliminate frame drops, but it should make those frame drops a bit shorter and less agnoizing than before.
## v1.0.0
- Initial public release.
- PG-13-ified everything.
## v0.0.1-alpha.3
- Initial release (on GitHub).
